locations.title: Cities
locations.description: One search per city on each platform, e.g. London, San Francisco, Berlin, Manchester, GB, Portland, US. Add a country code when a name is ambiguous.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional, e.g. AI, startup, python, networking, yoga. Meetup searches by keyword; Luma events are kept when the keyword appears as a whole word in the title, description or organiser.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Which sites to search: luma, meetup, or both.

lumaUrls.title: Luma pages
lumaUrls.description: Luma calendars, city pages or events, as URLs or slugs, e.g. lu.ma/genai-sf, lu.ma/nyc, lu.ma/sf, lu.ma/london.

meetupGroups.title: Meetup groups or events
meetupGroups.description: Meetup group URLs or names for their upcoming events, e.g. meetup.com/djangolondon, or single event URLs.

strictKeywordMatch.title: Strict keyword match on Meetup
strictKeywordMatch.description: Meetup's search is broad: "python" also returns Django and data-science events. On keeps only events whose title, description or group contains the keyword.

eventType.title: In person or online
eventType.description: Keep only this kind of event.

daysAhead.title: Within the next N days
daysAhead.description: Optional. Keep only events starting within this many days, e.g. 7 or 30.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Adds each event's full description. Same price either way.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max events per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each city, keyword, page or group after this many events.
